programmes.d: The investigation into the death of a woman whose remains were found in her Frisco, Texas, garage leads detectives to a series of suspects with connections to the victim's complicated and secretive life.
A man is shot and killed while picking up his daughter for a court-ordered visit.
An Air Force captain is shot dead leaving police to suspect his wife and her Army sharpshooter lover.
The investigation into the death of a Florida firefighter reveals a tale of secrets, lies and infidelity.
A Kentucky man is convicted of murdering his co-worker; the mystery is considered solved until a stunning disclosure years later turns the closed case upside down.
A pilot flees following a plane crash, becomes a fugitive and lives a double life for decades.
Brittany Stork's decades-long quest to find out more about her mother's mysterious death leads to a dramatic courtroom decision; the man at the center of the case tells his side of the story.
The mystery of a successful real estate entrepreneur killed by a car bomb spans nearly two decades.
A tale of sex, betrayal and murder: Inside the deadly love triangle where three became a crowd.
The trial and murder conviction of Jodi Arias and the salacious relationship that ended in tragedy.
A 29-year-old woman goes missing.
A man dies in a shooting incident after tempers flare in a confrontation in Montana's Glacier National Park.
A teen's murder shakes a Nevada community, especially when two unlikely people make confessions.
Intruders break into a family's home.

Kathleen Schroll makes a phone call right before her death where she identifies her killer, which leads to an arrest. Two trials and 12 years later, authorities begin to wonder who was really the victim.
A community is left in shock when a Cornell student and star athlete gets caught in the middle of a homicide investigation.
After filming wraps on an indie horror movie, the cast members learn their lead actress is not who she says she is and has been charged with killing her uncle.
A foreign exchange student and soccer player's participation in a dangerous game leads to deadly consequences.

When a soldier vanishes from Fort Hood, her family do everything they can to bring attention to her disappearance; Secretary of the Army Ryan McCarthy speaks about the investigation and allegations of sexual assault in the military.
A young art student from Texas is found murdered in her bed with no sign of forced entry, indicating that she knew her killer.
The murder of former NBA star and hometown hero Lorenzen Wright sends shockwaves through the city of Memphis; insiders speak out about new developments in the lengthy search for justice.
When Dr. Teresa Sievers is found murdered in her kitchen, detectives struggle to find any leads until an unexpected tip changes everything; the woman who helped investigators speaks out.
